data.name: Arjahaan
data.gender_notes: Arjahaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who brings happiness and joy. The name Arjahaan carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Arjahaan usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will bring joy and happiness to the family and spread positivity in the community
data.etymology: Arjahaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjahaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عريحان
in_arabic.meaning: يعني الأمانة والحياء والسماحة، من أصل عربي
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعني عريحان بالعربية الإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالحياء والأمانة، ويُعرف بأنه شخص ذو سماحة وحياء، حيث يُعتبر الحياء من الخمسين فعلًا حسنة في الإسلام، ويُعتبر الأمانة من أفضل الصفات عند الله، وقد يكون أيضًا اسمًا للشخص الذي يتمتع بالذكاء والبصيرة

data.cultural_impact: The name Arjahaan highlights the importance of spreading joy and happiness within families, communities, and society at large in Islamic culture. The emphasis on bringing happiness and joy to others reflects the Islamic values of kindness, generosity, and compassion towards others. It serves as an inspiration for individuals to contribute positively to others' lives and create an atmosphere of happiness and positivity around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Arjahaan is deep-rooted in the Islamic belief that every individual has the potential to bring joy and happiness to themselves and others, ultimately contributing to the betterment of humanity as a whole. This name is a reminder of the Mujaddid (renewer) role that every believer can play in their own unique way – by being kind, compassionate, and happily spreading positivity, hope, and love. It also highlights the connection between inner peace and outer happiness, encouraging individuals to cultivate a tranquil and contented spirit that radiates joy to those around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Joyful, Radiant" symbolizes The one who brings happiness and joy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Arjahaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of joyful, radiant.
